phrases.text: It's okay. You are safe, and I'm thinking about you.
Take a slow, deep breath with me. In, and out. You're doing great.
Everything is alright. Your nurse is right there if you need anything.
I miss you too. I love you very much.
You are never alone. I'm thinking about you right now.
How about we look at some pictures together when I'm back?
I'll be home later today. I can't wait to see you.
I'm coming back after work, like always.
I'll see you soon. Until then, you're in good hands.
Maybe it's a good time for a drink of water.
How about some music or your favorite show?
Ask your nurse what's next today. They know the plan.
